# Memory

> Cross-server short-lived storage over MemoryStoreService (sorted maps, queues).

- Package: `Memory` · Category: Data & players
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Memory")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Memory")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.Memory`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/MemoryStore.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Memory = GaxiaServer.Memory
```

### Functions

- `Memory.IsUsingFallback(): boolean`
- `Memory.MapSet(mapName: string, key: string, value: any, ttl: number, sortKey: number?): boolean`
- `Memory.MapGet(mapName: string, key: string): any`
- `Memory.MapRemove(mapName: string, key: string): boolean`
- `Memory.MapRange(mapName: string, count: number, ascending: boolean?): { MapRangeEntry }`
  Return up to `count` entries sorted by sortKey. ascending=false → highest first.
- `Memory.QueueAdd(queueName: string, value: any, ttl: number, priority: number?): boolean`
- `Memory.QueueRead(queueName: string, count: number): ({ any }, string?)`
  Read up to `count` items (highest priority first). Returns (values, readId); pass readId to QueueRemove to delete the read items.
- `Memory.QueueRemove(queueName: string, readId: string): boolean`
